payload.scope: cached calibration500 only; no inference except final latency

algorithms.baseline: Unchanged E1 low-floor detections; operating threshold selected on training fold from same grid as fusion. Stage E .34 is not used to choose OOF threshold.
algorithms.union: Concatenate E1 then E3 scores unchanged; stable class-aware NMS, suppress IoU>grid threshold, top300. No score calibration.
algorithms.wbf: E1-anchored asymmetric two-model WBF. Process E1 descending score, pair at most one unused same-class E3 with highest IoU>=threshold. Box=(w1*s1*b1+w3*s3*b3)/(w1*s1+w3*s3); score=w1*s1+w3*s3. Unmatched E1 unchanged; unmatched E3 not added.
algorithms.recovery: Preserve all E1 values; add high-confidence E3 only when max ANY-class IoU against E1 anchors with score>=.20 and previously accepted additions is <grid IoU. Never evict E1 at max300. Training-fold GT support<100: E1-only. Among eligible classes, E3 training AP50:95<E1 class AP: require max(grid addition threshold,.55); otherwise grid addition threshold. Class rules fitted only on training folds.

payload.selection_rule: For each family/train fold maximize macro class F1 over parameter x operating grid; round12 tie then prefer higher operating threshold, larger E1 weight, higher addition threshold, lower IoU, lexical candidate ID. No AP-based parameter search beyond fixed weak-class rule.
payload.cross_validation: Five deterministic image folds. Training labels only select params/threshold/support/weak-class rules; selected model evaluated once per held-out fold. Pooled low-floor OOF predictions determine AP; fold-specific threshold-filtered predictions separately determine fixed P/R/F1/confusion. Full OOF pool used to compare families, so this is model-selection evidence, not an unbiased final test.

gate.distributed: For the metric meeting gain gate, at least two classes with >=100 GT improve by >=.01; mean per-class gain excluding largest-GT class is positive.
gate.duplicates: Increase in duplicate count <=max(10,25% baseline duplicate count) AND duplicate/prediction-rate increase <=.02.
gate.reproduction: Bitwise-equivalent canonical prediction hashes from repeated deterministic fusion with same configuration.
gate.target: Report P>=.70 and R>=.70; never tune to force target.

payload.family_selection: Among passing families maximize pooled OOF macro F1, then AP50:95, then fixed family order. If none pass reject E4; strongest nonbaseline OOF macro-F1 family is benchmarked only.
payload.final_fit: If pass, tune winning family on all calibration500 using exactly same grid/rule, freeze final code/config and evaluate once. If reject, no extra search/full-set score: benchmark fold0 training-selected configuration of strongest OOF family, explicitly unselected.

AP.absent_classes: COCO precision=-1 excluded from macro AP; zero-prediction supported class AP=0

payload.PR_curves: COCO low-floor interpolated PR at IoU .50, distinct from fold-specific operating points.
payload.latency: Existing Stage D seed42 calibration100 sample; MPS float32 batch1,10warmups,one timed pass; actual E1 then E3 inference then fusion. Include file decode, both detector preprocess/inference/NMS, coordinate conversion, CPU transfer and fusion/filter; report load excluded. No video FPS.
forbidden: Any image/label path not in hash-verified calibration500 allowlist; do not enumerate or hash reserved paths
